rows.text: Monetary Policy Committee's Decision on 25 August 2010
announces the outcome of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting today, as
The global economy continued to recover during the first half of the year,
The Thai economy expanded faster than expected in the second quarter,
Inflationary pressure remains low at present, but is expected to rise in 2011 in
that core inflation could rise above the upper band of the target range.
The MPC therefore decided to raise the policy interest rate by 0.25 per cent
